# Orange Cat controls

For the Nightly v0.16.0-2e1056 and later (firmware commit 52a41894, November 5, 2026). Made from the firmware's tables ea3fb820: when they change, this page is made again.

What every knob, button and key does on the unit, page by page. It describes the Nightly build: the new interface with HOME's pictures, the four knobs and the EDIT sheets, with the FX order SENDS first and the track's own effects last.

Names are the ones on the screen and the panel: KNOB 1 to KNOB 4, SELECT, PRESETS, ALGORITHM, EDIT, HOME, SEQ, GLO, FX, ARP, SCL, ENV, LFO, REC, PLAY, SAVE, OCT- and OCT+. The 27 keys run from F3 to G5. Keys are named by note: F3, F#3, C4.

The parameter names and ranges in the page tables come straight from the firmware's tables, so they follow it. The sentences about what a control does are written by hand and checked by a test against the same tables.

## Controls that work the same everywhere

- A tap is a press let go before 0.7 s. HOME, REC, SAVE, EDIT, SEQ and OCT+ also do something when held for 0.7 s.
- ALGORITHM picks the track, T1 to T4, one per click, no wrap. Only tracks in use count.
- PRESETS browses the selected track's sounds on HOME and on the PRESETS page. On other pages it has a job only where the page says so.
- KNOB 1 to KNOB 4 edit the four columns of the page. MENU > KNOB ACCEL makes fast turns step further.
- SELECT steps the page inside the button's family. On HOME it turns what MENU > HOME SELECT says (BPM until you change it). With GLO held, on any page, it turns what MENU > GLO SELECT says. With SEQ held it switches the selected track to the next or previous of its 8 pattern banks.
- OCT- and OCT+ shift the keys' octave on HOME (-3 to +3; both together put it back to 0). On every other page, and in sheets, menus and dialogs, they are Esc and Enter: OCT- leaves or cancels, OCT+ enters or does the page's action.
- OCT+ held for 0.7 s opens the page's sheet, a card of actions. In a sheet KNOB 2 picks the row, KNOB 1 changes the row's value, OCT+ does the row and OCT- closes the sheet. The sound's sheet (Init sound, Save as user, Favourite, Undo last load, Sound designer) belongs to HOME and to the EDIT, ENV, LFO and track FX pages; HOME's adds Add track and Remove track. The shared FX pages have Reset effects. SEQ's pages, CHAIN, SONG, PHRASES, MIXER, MOTION, PROJECT and USER have their own.
- EDIT held for 0.7 s is undo: the last sound load, or on a step page the last step edit. With EDIT held, OCT- undoes and OCT+ redoes.
- LFO held while turning a knob on a sound page (HOME's knobs, EDIT, ENV, LFO, a track's FX pages, TEMPO's BPM and SWG) is a momentary tweak. The value goes back when LFO is let go; press OCT+ while LFO is held to keep it. It does nothing on lists, step pages, slots, module pages and the shared FX pages.
- The keys play the selected track. They do not when a layer button is held (the keys are the layer's, silent), on the NAME screen, in step entry on NOTES, TRACKER and GRID and on the drum grid, and on HOME's DUB page (C4 to B4).
- PLAY, tap: start or stop. What it plays depends on the page it is pressed on. SONG: the song from the row picked (an empty song plays the chains). CHAIN: each track's chain. NOTES and PHRASE: each track loops its phrase. Any other page, TRACKER and GRID and HOME included: what it played last. REC + PLAY records now. With GLO held PLAY restarts from the top.
- REC, tap: arm or disarm recording on the selected track (not on SONG: "[SEQ] TO RECORD"). REC held: see "REC held" below.
- SAVE, tap: opens the SAVE pages, PROJECT first. A tap again on PROJECT goes to USER; on USER, back to PROJECT. SAVE held for 0.7 s, or SAVE + REC: quick save to the slot in use (stop the music first). With ARP held, SAVE + a white key stores a scene.
- In a dialog OCT+ does it and OCT- cancels. Nothing else reacts.
- A frozen track refuses edits to its notes, steps and PHRASE values ("UNFREEZE TO EDIT").
- HOME held for 0.7 s alone opens the MENU (see the menu at the end).

## HOME as SHIFT

Press or turn something within 0.7 s of pressing HOME and it is a shortcut, not the MENU. They work on HOME's pages, on a sheet's rows, and on NOTES and FEEL. Elsewhere HOME + a knob, PRESETS or EDIT does nothing.

- HOME + KNOB 1 to 4: a fine turn, one detent, no acceleration.
- HOME + PRESETS: the engine, one step a click, on HOME's pages. On NOTES and FEEL it stretches the selected steps.
- HOME + EDIT: Init sound (it asks first) on HOME's pages and sheets. On NOTES it deletes the selected notes; on FEEL it puts the steps' feel back to the defaults.
- HOME + OCT- or OCT+ only says "COPY, PASTE: LATER". There is no copy and paste in this build.
- HOME tapped alone goes to HOME. Tapped again on HOME it steps HOME's pages.

## SEQ held: the pattern keys

SEQ is not a layer, but with it held the keys are silent pattern keys. SEQ tapped steps the SEQ pages. SEQ held 0.7 s alone jumps to CHAIN (on MOTION it waits for release).

- White keys F3 G3 A3 B3 C4 D4 E4 F4 are the selected track's chain slots A to H. A tap goes to the slot (playing: at the end of the loop). A tap on an empty slot also arms one recording pass; the same key again at once is REC.
- Held for 1 s a slot key opens a dialog: the same key again deletes the slot's phrase, another white key copies it there (stopped only), C#4 halves and D#4 doubles the phrase length, OCT- closes.
- Black keys F#3 G#3 A#3 C#4 pick T1 to T4.
- On HOME's DUB page the keys C4 to B4 stay DUB's keys with SEQ held: slots A to D and T1 to T3 are on the keys below; for slots E to H or T4 leave the DUB page.
- SELECT: the next or previous pattern bank of the selected track (while playing, at the loop end; refused while a song plays: "STOP SONG TO SWITCH").
- On MOTION, SEQ + KNOB 2 clears the lane and SEQ + KNOB 4 deletes a point.

## REC held, REC, count-in, undo

- REC held with the music stopped is a clear with a countdown. After 0.35 s the header says what it clears and counts 3, 2, 1 at 0.3 s each; the clear happens at about 1.25 s if REC is still down. Let go early and nothing is cleared ("KEPT"). Any other button, a key, a track or page change, or starting PLAY cancels it.
- What it clears depends on the page. HOME: the selected track's steps and notes. NOTES, FEEL, TRACKER: the 16 steps of the page back to the defaults (chance, condition, ratchet, nudge, accent, slide). PHRASE: LEN, DIV, SWG and GATE back to the defaults. A track's FX page (SENDS, DIST, AUTO PAN, DUB SETUP, DUB, DUB 2): that track's effects. MIXER and the GLO pages: every track's steps, notes and own effects, not the shared effects, the tempo or the sounds. MOTION: the track's automation lanes.
- Nothing is cleared on GRID, TEMPO, CHAIN, SONG, PHRASES and GROOVE (it says so), and on a shared FX page it only says where Reset effects is (OCT+ held).
- On EDIT, ENV, LFO, SCL, ARP and SAVE pages, in menus and in layers, REC held is Capture. Every clear is one undo level: EDIT held brings it back.
- REC held with the music playing is Capture: what the track played in its last bars is written into its phrase as recorded notes.
- REC + PLAY arms the selected track and starts. An armed track with the music stopped starts with its first note.
- MENU > COUNT-IN (OFF, 1 BAR, 2 BARS) counts in with the click when PLAY is pressed with a track armed, on the internal clock only. PLAY during the count-in cancels it.
- Undo is EDIT held, with EDIT + OCT- to undo and EDIT + OCT+ to redo. OCT- inside the GLO, SCL and ARP layers only puts back what that layer changed.

## HOME

HOME has up to four pages. MENU > HOME PAGE chooses the first. With TRACKS (the default) a HOME tap on HOME toggles TRACKS and CHORD. With PICTURE it steps PICTURE, DUB, TRACKS, CHORD; DUB is in the turn only while the selected track's ECHO is above 0.

- TRACKS: one row per track in use, with its numeral, sound name and the bar's 16 steps; the selected track is outlined. Under them the notes played over the waveform. A muted track is grey and says MUTE in red where its role (DRUMS, CHORDS, T1) stands; a frozen track is grey-blue and says FROZEN. KNOB 1 to 4 are the selected engine's first four values; they drop in over the rows when turned.
- CHORD: the twelve notes as a wheel in fifths with the song's key. Notes sounding on the tracks are lit in the track colors and the chord is named in the middle. The knobs drop in over the wheel.
- PICTURE: the sound line (track, sound name, its place in the factory list; a knob turned shows its name and value there), four dials in the knob colors (blue, green, white, orange), a value row and the engine's picture. PACK MISSING in red means the asset pack is not installed. A macro knob moves around the sound as stored (-64 to +63); going back to TRACKS keeps the offsets in the sound. While the selected track is muted its numeral is grey and the line says MUTE in red at the right (also on DUB).
- DUB: the tape loop and the performance keys, see "DUB performance view".
- On every HOME page: SELECT turns HOME SELECT (BPM at first). PRESETS browses the sounds; a fast turn loads when it rests. EDIT opens the EDIT sheets. ENV, LFO, SCL, ARP, FX, GLO, SAVE and SEQ open their pages. OCT- and OCT+ shift the octave. PLAY plays what it played last. REC held (stopped) clears the selected track. SAVE opens PROJECT.

HOME's four knobs by engine:

| Engine | KNOB 1 to 4 on TRACKS | KNOB 1 to 4 on PICTURE |
|---|---|---|
| MACRO | MODL HARM TIMB MRPH | HARM TIMB MRPH PLUCK (macro) |
| DRUM-X | MRPH TUNE TONE DECY | MRPH TUNE TONE DECY |

## EDIT: the sheets

EDIT opens a sheet: a tab with rows, each row a page. From HOME, or from a page that is not an EDIT, ENV or LFO row, it opens the first sheet's first row. On a row it goes to the next sheet (it wraps).

- For a MACRO track the sheets are: Sound (rows MODEL, SHAPE, then SLIDE), Env (ENV, ENV DEST), Mod (LFO, LFO 2, LFO DEST, MOD), FX (a link to the FX pages) and Voice (the VOICE list).
- For a DRUM-X track: Kit (KIT, KIT 2, SLIDE), Lanes (LANES, LANES 2, LANES 3), Env, Mod, FX and Voice.
- SELECT walks the rows and on into the next sheet. PRESETS steps the sheets (no wrap). ENV and LFO jump to their rows. EDIT on the FX sheet's pages goes to the sheet after the link.
- A module engine brings its own EDIT pages; they show only for that engine.
- OCT+ held opens the sound's sheet. LFO held + a knob is a momentary tweak.

## Shortcut layers: GLO, SCL, ARP and FX held

- The gesture: let go before the hold time with nothing else touched and it is a tap: the button's page opens. Held longer alone, it is a peek: the map shows and letting go does nothing. A key, knob or button meanwhile makes it a combo.
- Keys pressed while the layer button is down are the layer's: silent, no MIDI, never recorded. Keys already held before stay notes.
- On HOME's DUB page the octave C4 to B4 stays DUB's keys while a layer button is held: a KICK (C#4) played with ARP, GLO or FX still down is a KICK, not MUTE T4. The layer's other keys work as ever. For the layer's own C4 to B4 keys, lock the layer (double-tap) or leave the DUB page.
- Double-tap the button (second press within 0.3 s, then let go before the hold time) to lock the layer open. The header says LOCK. Press the button again to unlock; any other button closes it.
- Only one layer at a time. PLAY and REC work in every layer; SAVE, HOME, SEQ and the other page buttons are swallowed. No layer opens in the menu, a dialog or the NAME screen.
- In the GLO, SCL and ARP layers OCT- and OCT+ do not shift the octave.

### [GLO] SET

Hold GLO for the hold time (MENU > HOLD, 0.3 to 0.6 s, 0.4 s at first), or press a key or knob while it is down. Tap it quickly and GLO opens MIXER, then GLOBAL, SYSTEM, WEIGHTS and WEIGHTS 2.

The screen's footer: RESTART, UNDO, DONE.

| Key | Does |
|---|---|
| F#3 G#3 A#3 C#4 | MUTE T1 to T4. Latched; a lit key is sounding. |
| F3 G3 A3 B3 | SOLO T1 to T4 while held. |
| C4 | Unmute all. |
| F4 | Tap tempo (internal clock only; the tempo is set from the third tap). |

KNOB 1 to 4: LEVEL of T1 to T4 (recorded as motion when armed).

- SELECT: what MENU > GLO SELECT says (BPM at first).
- PLAY: RESTART from the top without stopping.
- OCT- (on release): puts back the mutes, levels and BPM from when the layer opened ("MIX PUT BACK"). OCT+ does nothing.

### [SCL] SET

Hold SCL. On NOTES and TRACKER of a pitched track SCL held is a step modifier instead (it moves the note in time).

The screen's footer: ROOT, UNDO, DONE.

| Key | Does |
|---|---|
| any key | Sets ROOT to that key's note name (F3 is F). The key lights show the root and the scale's notes blink. |

KNOB 1 to 4: ROOT, SCL (the scale), CHRD, VOIC.

- OCT-: puts back the root, scale, QNT, TRN, chord and voicing from when the layer opened ("SCALE PUT BACK").

### [ARP] PERF

Hold ARP. This is PERFORM.

The screen's footer: + KEY: STORE, UNDO.

| Key | Does |
|---|---|
| F3 G3 A3 B3 C4 D4 E4 F4 | Scenes 1 to 8. A tap recalls the scene (playing: at the launch point). SAVE held + a key stores it. A scene keeps each track's chain, slot and MUTE. |
| F#3 G#3 A#3 C#4 | MUTE T1 to T4, staged for the launch point (stopped: at once; again before it lands: unstaged). |
| D#4 (held) | FILL: steps whose condition is FILL play, !FILL ones do not. |

KNOB 1: LAUNCH LOOP, BAR, BEAT or NOW (where a scene, staged mute or hand-picked slot comes in while playing). KNOB 2, 3, 4: throw the selected track's REV, DLY and CHO sends; they glide back over a bar once the knob rests.

- OCT-: puts back the mutes and LAUNCH ("PERFORM PUT BACK").

### [FX] PUNCH

Hold FX. Keys held play an effect on the whole mix while held. They start on the next 1/16 when playing and are never recorded.

The screen's footer: HOLD: EFFECT, ALL OFF.

| Key | Does |
|---|---|
| F3 G3 A3 | REPEAT 1/8, 1/16, 1/32 (1/8 needs about 81 BPM or more). |
| B3 | GLITCH. |
| C4 | TAPE STOP. |
| F#3 G#3 A#3 C#4 | MUTE T1 to T4 while held. |
| G#4 | FREEZE. |
| C#5 | SHUFFLE. |
| D#5 | CRUSH (a sweep over two bars). |
| F#5 | THROW: the mix into the delay and reverb. |

With a GLITCH, TAPE, SHUFFLE or FREEZE key down, KNOB 1 to 4 are its settings (never saved). GLITCH: DENS, PITCH, SIZE, VARI. TAPE: SCRATCH, TIME, CURVE. SHUFFLE: AMOUNT, SIZE, SPEED, VARI. FREEZE: DENS, PITCH, SPRAY, SIZE. With none down, KNOB 4 is FILTER, a low-pass on the whole mix.

- OCT-: every effect off ("PUNCH-IN: ALL OFF"). Held effects do not change the octave.

## The pages

Where a page says "Buttons as ...", the family's buttons above apply. On the SEQ pages that need no step editing the keys play the track.

### FX: the effects

FX tapped from a page outside the family lands on SENDS. Each tap steps on: SENDS, DELAY, DELAY 2, DELAY 3, REVERB, REVERB 2, CHORUS, SLICER, SLICER 2, SL PITCH 1 to 4 (only while the slicer is on and its LEN reaches them), MASTER, then the track's own DIST, AUTO PAN, DUB SETUP, DUB, DUB 2, then SENDS again. SELECT steps the same way. FX held is the PUNCH layer.

- SENDS, DIST, AUTO PAN and the three DUB pages are the selected track's own; the others are shared by all tracks.
- Buttons: FX = next FX page. EDIT = the next sheet. OCT- = HOME. On a track's page OCT+ held opens the sound's sheet and REC held (stopped) resets the track's effects. On a shared page OCT+ held opens Reset effects (all shared settings back to a new project's; it asks) and REC held only says where that is.
- Delay, reverb and chorus need memory when a send is above 0. "FX FULL" means there was none and the effect plays dry.

#### SENDS

- KNOB 1: DIST (0 to 100 %). The track's drive, the distortion amount.
- KNOB 2: CHO (0 to 100 %). The track's send to the shared chorus.
- KNOB 3: DLY (0 to 100 %). The send to the shared delay.
- KNOB 4: REV (0 to 100 %). The send to the shared reverb.

#### DELAY

- KNOB 1: TIME (64 values: 1/4, 1/8, 1/16, 1/32, 8T, 16T, 1/2, 1/1, 2BAR, 4BAR on the tempo, then free times from 5 ms to 2.95 s). Delay time.
- KNOB 2: FDBK (0 to 94 %). How much repeats feed back.
- KNOB 3: TONE (0 to 100 %). Darker below the middle, thinner above.
- KNOB 4: MIX (0 to 100 %). Delay level in the mix.

#### DELAY 2

- KNOB 1: WIDE (0 to 100 %). Stereo width.
- KNOB 2: PITCH (-12 to +12 st). Pitch of the repeats (grain delay).
- KNOB 3: SPRAY (0 to 100 %). Grain spray.
- KNOB 4: MOD (0 to 100 %). Wow and flutter.

#### DELAY 3

- KNOB 1: TYPE (ANALOG, DIGITAL). ANALOG or DIGITAL repeats.
- KNOB 2: PING (OFF, ON). Ping-pong off or on.
- KNOB 3: empty.
- KNOB 4: empty.

#### REVERB

- KNOB 1: TYPE (ROOM, SPRING, SHIMR, RESO, CLOUD). ROOM, SPRING, SHIMR, RESO or CLOUD.
- KNOB 2: SIZE (0 to 100 %). Size. On CLOUD, 100 % freezes what it holds.
- KNOB 3: DAMP (0 to 100 %). Damping. On RESO it becomes FOLW: OFF or T1 to T4, the track it tunes to.
- KNOB 4: PRE (0 to 100 ms; on SHIMR and CLOUD AIR -24 to +24 st; on RESO PITCH 0 to 14). Pre-delay.

#### REVERB 2

- KNOB 1: MOD (0 to 100 %). Modulation depth.
- KNOB 2: RATE (a rate in Hz). Modulation rate.
- KNOB 3: FILT (-100 to +98 %). Filter: left darker, right thinner.
- KNOB 4: WIDE (0 to 100 %). Stereo width.

#### CHORUS

- KNOB 1: RATE (a rate in Hz). Rate.
- KNOB 2: DEPTH (0 to 100 %). Depth.
- KNOB 3: WIDE (-100 to +98 %). Stereo width.
- KNOB 4: empty.

#### SLICER

- KNOB 1: MODE (OFF, GATE, STUT). OFF, GATE or STUT. STUT needs extra memory and can say FX FULL.
- KNOB 2: PAT (1 to 16). The gate pattern.
- KNOB 3: RATE (1/8, 1/16, 1/32, 8T, 16T, 32T). Step rate.
- KNOB 4: DEPTH (0 to 100 %). Depth.

#### SLICER 2

- KNOB 1: FX (OFF, ON). Whether the effects' return goes through the slicer.
- KNOB 2: LEN (1 to 16). How many pitch steps the slicer uses.
- KNOB 3: QUANT (CHR or SCL). Quantize the pitch steps to the chromatic scale or the track's scale.
- KNOB 4: empty.

#### SL PITCH 1

Only while the slicer is on and its LEN reaches the page.

- KNOB 1: PITCH (-24 to +24 st). Pitch of slicer step 1.
- KNOB 2: PITCH (-24 to +24 st). Pitch of step 2.
- KNOB 3: PITCH (-24 to +24 st). Pitch of step 3.
- KNOB 4: PITCH (-24 to +24 st). Pitch of step 4.

#### SL PITCH 2

Only while the slicer is on and its LEN reaches the page.

- KNOB 1: PITCH (-24 to +24 st). Pitch of slicer step 5.
- KNOB 2: PITCH (-24 to +24 st). Pitch of step 6.
- KNOB 3: PITCH (-24 to +24 st). Pitch of step 7.
- KNOB 4: PITCH (-24 to +24 st). Pitch of step 8.

#### SL PITCH 3

Only while the slicer is on and its LEN reaches the page.

- KNOB 1: PITCH (-24 to +24 st). Pitch of slicer step 9.
- KNOB 2: PITCH (-24 to +24 st). Pitch of step 10.
- KNOB 3: PITCH (-24 to +24 st). Pitch of step 11.
- KNOB 4: PITCH (-24 to +24 st). Pitch of step 12.

#### SL PITCH 4

Only while the slicer is on and its LEN reaches the page.

- KNOB 1: PITCH (-24 to +24 st). Pitch of slicer step 13.
- KNOB 2: PITCH (-24 to +24 st). Pitch of step 14.
- KNOB 3: PITCH (-24 to +24 st). Pitch of step 15.
- KNOB 4: PITCH (-24 to +24 st). Pitch of step 16.

#### MASTER

- KNOB 1: DJF (-100 to +98 %). The DJ filter: left darker, right thinner.
- KNOB 2: CLIP (0 to 100 %). Clipper amount.
- KNOB 3: LEVEL (OFF, ON). The leveler, off until you turn it on.
- KNOB 4: SPK (OFF, LOWCUT, BASS+). Speaker EQ: OFF, LOWCUT or BASS+.

#### DIST

- KNOB 1: DIST (0 to 100 %). Drive (the same value as SENDS' KNOB 1).
- KNOB 2: TYPE (SOFT, HARD, FOLD, CRUSH, RECT, AMP). Distortion type.
- KNOB 3: TONE (-100 to +98 %). Tone.
- KNOB 4: SLC (OFF, ON). Sends the track through the slicer.

#### AUTO PAN

- KNOB 1: DEPTH (0 to 100 %). Depth.
- KNOB 2: RATE (Hz when SYNC is FREE; 4BAR to 1/32 when SYNC is BEAT). Rate.
- KNOB 3: SYNC (FREE, BEAT). FREE or BEAT.
- KNOB 4: WAVE (SIN, TRI, SAW, SQR, S&H). Wave: SIN, TRI, SAW, SQR, S&H.

#### DUB SETUP

Needs the DUB TAPE module to sound. Without it a track with ECHO above 0 plays dry and the screen says MODULE MISSING.

- KNOB 1: SYNC (FREE or SYNC). Whether the times are free (ms) or on the beat.
- KNOB 2: TIM L (synced: 1/32 to 1/1, with D dotted and T triplet; free: 20 ms to 1.4 s). Left echo time.
- KNOB 3: TIM R (as TIM L). Right echo time.
- KNOB 4: PING (OFF or ON). Ping-pong.

#### DUB

Needs the DUB TAPE module. HOME's DUB page shows the same four knobs with the performance keys.

- KNOB 1: FDBK (0 to 127). Feedback. 100 is unity; above it the echo builds up.
- KNOB 2: SEND (0 to 127). How much of the track goes to the echo.
- KNOB 3: FILTER (0 to 127). Below 64 a low-pass closes, 64 is open, above is a high-pass.
- KNOB 4: ECHO (0 to 127). Echo level. 0 turns the track's DUB off (the same as CUT).

#### DUB 2

Needs the DUB TAPE module.

- KNOB 1: SPRNG (0 to 100 %). Spring reverb.
- KNOB 2: DRIVE (0 to 15). Tape drive.
- KNOB 3: WOW (0 to 11). Tape wow.
- KNOB 4: SPEED (-12 to +11 st, 0 in the middle). Pitch of the repeats.

### ENV: the envelope

ENV tapped opens ENV, tapped again ENV DEST, then back. They are also the Env rows of the EDIT sheets. On a step page ENV held is a modifier; tapped alone it opens these pages. Engines with their own envelope hide them (not MACRO or DRUM-X).

- Buttons: ENV = next page. EDIT = next sheet. OCT+ held = the sound's sheet. LFO held + a knob = momentary tweak. OCT- = HOME. PRESETS steps the sheets; SELECT steps the rows.

#### ENV

- KNOB 1: ATK (a time, ms to s). Attack time.
- KNOB 2: DEC (a time, ms to s). Decay time.
- KNOB 3: SUS (0 to 100 %). Sustain level.
- KNOB 4: REL (a time, ms to s). Release time.

- The page draws the envelope.

#### ENV DEST

- KNOB 1: FLT (-100 to +98 %). How far the envelope moves the filter (on MACRO it moves MRPH).
- KNOB 2: PIT (-100 to +98 %). How far it moves the pitch.
- KNOB 3: SHP (-100 to +98 %). How far it moves the shape (on MACRO it moves TIMB).
- KNOB 4: empty.

### LFO: the LFO and the modulation matrix

LFO tapped opens LFO, then LFO 2, LFO DEST and MOD, then back. They are also the Mod rows of the EDIT sheets.

- Buttons as ENV. LFO held is the momentary tweak, so a tap is needed to open the pages.

#### LFO

- KNOB 1: RATE (a rate in Hz). Rate (dimmed when LFO 2's SYNC is on: the rate does nothing then).
- KNOB 2: WAVE (SIN, TRI, SAW, SQR, S&H). Wave: SIN, TRI, SAW, SQR, S&H.
- KNOB 3: PHS (0 to 127). Start phase.
- KNOB 4: FADE (a time, ms to s). Fade-in time.

- The page draws the wave.

#### LFO 2

- KNOB 1: SYNC (OFF, 4BAR, 2BAR, 1/1, 1/2, 1/4, 1/8, 8T, 1/16, 16T, 1/32). Locks the LFO to the beat. OFF leaves it free.
- KNOB 2: TRIG (NOTE, FREE). Restart on each NOTE or run FREE.
- KNOB 3: POL (BI, UNI). BI (both ways) or UNI (one way).
- KNOB 4: empty.

#### LFO DEST

- KNOB 1: PIT (-100 to +98 %). How far the LFO moves the pitch.
- KNOB 2: FLT (-100 to +98 %). How far it moves the filter (on MACRO it moves MRPH).
- KNOB 3: SHP (-100 to +98 %). How far it moves the shape (on MACRO it moves TIMB).
- KNOB 4: AMP (0 to 100 %). How far it moves the level.

#### MOD

- KNOB 1: SRC1 (OFF, LFO, ENV, VEL, KEY, RAND, MODW, AT, EXPR, S&H, SLEW). The source of the route shown: OFF, LFO, ENV, VEL, KEY, RAND, MODW, AT, EXPR, S&H or SLEW.
- KNOB 2: SLOT (1/4 to 4/4, no wrap). Which of the four routes.
- KNOB 3: DST1 (PITCH, CUT, SHP, AMP, PAN, RATE, VIB, DEPTH or E1 to E8 under the engine's own names). The destination.
- KNOB 4: AMT1 (-100 to +98 %). The amount.

- A knob that picks a name from a long list opens a picker card (MENU > PICKER POPUPS).

### SCL: scale and chords

SCL tapped opens SCL, then CHORD, then back. SCALES and MPC are inside SCL's list.

- Keys play the track. EDIT opens the sheets. OCT- = HOME. SCL held is the SET layer (or the note-move modifier on NOTES and TRACKER).

#### SCALES

Only from SCL: pick the Scale row (KNOB 2) and press OCT+. It is not in SCL's round. OCT- or OCT+ goes back to SCL.

- KNOB 1: FAMILY (All, Western, EDO, Just, Harmonic, Historical, Regional, Non-octave, Maqam, Faves). The family of scales.
- KNOB 2: SCL (CHR to SIKAH (70 values)). The scale in that family; the one shown is the track's at once (70 scales in all).
- KNOB 3: ROOT (0 to 11). The root note.
- KNOB 4: QNT (OFF, SNAP, WHITE, ALL, MPC). Key quantize: OFF, SNAP, WHITE, ALL, MPC.

- PRESETS steps the scale. The cards show the scale's notes, period and star.

#### SCL

- A list page: KNOB 2 picks the row and KNOB 1 changes its value. KNOB 3 and KNOB 4 do nothing.

- Rows: Root (C to B). Scale (steps through the family last used in SCALES). Quantize (OFF, SNAP, WHITE, ALL, MPC). MPC degree (only while Quantize is MPC). Transpose (-24 to +24 st). Favourite (ON marks the scale's star).
- OCT+ on the Scale row opens SCALES. OCT+ on a row whose value is a name opens the whole list. The picture is an octave of keys with the scale lit and the root marked.

#### CHORD

- KNOB 1: CHRD (OFF, DIA3, DIA7, MAJ, MIN, DOM7, MAJ7, MIN7, SUS4, POW). The chord a key plays on the track's root and scale: OFF, DIA3, DIA7, MAJ, MIN, DOM7, MAJ7, MIN7, SUS4, POW.
- KNOB 2: VOIC (CLOSE, OPEN, INV1, INV2, +OCT). The voicing: CLOSE, OPEN, INV1, INV2, +OCT.
- KNOB 3: STRUM (OFF, 1/8, 1/16, 1/32, 1/64, 1/128, 16T, 32T). How long the chord takes to strum.
- KNOB 4: STROKE (DOWN, UP, ALT). Strum direction: DOWN, UP or ALT.

- Keys play chords when CHRD is on.

#### MPC

Only as a row of SCL, and only while Quantize is MPC. It is not a page of its own.

- KNOB 1: DEG (1 to the number of notes in the scale). The scale degree the second pad of each bank plays under QNT MPC.
- KNOB 2: empty.
- KNOB 3: empty.
- KNOB 4: empty.

### EDIT: the sound's pages

The EDIT button opens the sheets (see "EDIT: the sheets"). Pages here are rows of those sheets.

- Buttons: EDIT = next sheet. OCT+ held = the sound's sheet. ENV and LFO jump to their rows. PRESETS = next or previous sheet; SELECT = next or previous row. LFO held + a knob = momentary tweak. A knob with a long name list opens a picker card (MENU > PICKER POPUPS).

#### EDIT 1

- MACRO: KNOB 1 MODL (VA to SPEECH (25 values)), KNOB 2 HARM (0 to 100 %), KNOB 3 TIMB (0 to 100 %), KNOB 4 MRPH (0 to 100 %).
- DRUM-X: KNOB 1 MRPH (0 to 100 %), KNOB 2 TUNE (0 to 100 %), KNOB 3 TONE (0 to 100 %), KNOB 4 DECY (0 to 100 %).

- A knob with a long name list (MODL) opens a picker card. Other engines (modules) have their own labels and show only for that engine.

#### EDIT 2

- MACRO: KNOB 1 AUX (0 to 100 %), KNOB 2 LPG (0 to 100 %), KNOB 3 DECY (0 to 100 %), KNOB 4 TMOD (-100 to +98 %).
- DRUM-X: KNOB 1 NOIS (0 to 100 %), KNOB 2 FM (0 to 100 %), KNOB 3 FOLD (0 to 100 %), KNOB 4 DRV (0 to 100 %).

#### LANES

Only for DRUM-X, as the Lanes sheet's first row.

- KNOB 1: LEVEL (0 to 100 %). The picked lane's level.
- KNOB 2: TUNE (-12.0 to +11.8 st). The lane's tuning; about a fifth of a semitone a click.
- KNOB 3: DECAY (-100 to +98 %). The lane's decay.
- KNOB 4: PAN (L100 to C to R98). Turning across the middle stops at C first.

- The page is a table of the eight lanes (KICK, SNARE, CLAP, HAT CL, HAT OP, TOM, RIM, BELL). The picked lane shows its four numbers, the others bars.
- PRESETS picks the lane. A key struck on the track picks its lane and plays it.

#### LANES 2

DRUM-X only. Buttons and PRESETS as LANES.

- KNOB 1: LAYER (0 to 15). The lane's second oscillator.
- KNOB 2: PUNCH (0 to 15). Punch.
- KNOB 3: ATK+ (0 to 15). Attack; 8 is about 35 ms.
- KNOB 4: BEND (-12 to +12 st). A glide over one step.

#### LANES 3

DRUM-X only. Buttons and PRESETS as LANES.

- KNOB 1: TONE (0 to 15). A band-pass on hats, rim and bell (the whole kit's).
- KNOB 2: FDBK (0 to 15). A growl on every sound.
- KNOB 3: HANDS (0 to 15). More hands on the clap.
- KNOB 4: DUCK (0 to 100 %). The kick pushes the non-drum tracks down.

#### VOICE

- A list page: KNOB 2 picks the row and KNOB 1 changes its value. KNOB 3 and KNOB 4 do nothing.

- VOICE is a list. The rows are VCE (POLY, MONO, LEG, UNI), GLD (glide time), GLMOD (RATE or TIME), PRIO (LAST, LOW, HIGH), ALLOC (ROT or REUSE), DTUNE, PAN, MUTE (OFF or ON) and SPRD (stereo spread). VOICE 2 and VOICE 3 below are its last rows, not pages of their own.
- OCT+ on a name row opens that value's whole list.

#### VOICE 2

Rows of the VOICE list, never a page of their own.

- KNOB 1: ALLOC (ROT, REUSE). Voice allocation: ROT or REUSE.
- KNOB 2: DTUNE (0 to 127). Detune between voices.
- KNOB 3: PAN (-100 to +98 %). Track pan.
- KNOB 4: MUTE (OFF, ON). Track mute.

#### SLIDE

The last row of the Sound or Kit sheet.

- KNOB 1: SLIDE (-100 to +98 %). How long a step's SLIDE takes on this track. 0 is the old rate; each 16 down is twice as quick, each 16 up half as quick.
- KNOB 2: empty.
- KNOB 3: empty.
- KNOB 4: empty.

- NOTES with ENV held, and TRACKER's FX column, show it as a word: SNAP, FAST, QUICK, NORM, EASY, SLOW, LONG. A track's GLIDE, if set, still wins.

#### VOICE 3

The last row of the VOICE list.

- KNOB 1: SPRD (0 to 100 %). Stereo spread of the voices.
- KNOB 2: empty.
- KNOB 3: empty.
- KNOB 4: empty.

### GLO: global pages

GLO tapped from a page outside GLO's pages lands on MIXER. Tapped again: GLOBAL, SYSTEM, WEIGHTS, WEIGHTS 2, then MIXER. SELECT steps GLOBAL to WEIGHTS 2 (MIXER is not in SELECT's round). GLO held is the SET layer.

- Buttons: GLO = next page. OCT- = HOME. EDIT = the EDIT sheets. REC held (stopped) clears every track's steps, notes and own effects (3, 2, 1). The keys play the track.

#### GLOBAL

- KNOB 1: A4 (400 to 480). The tuning reference.
- KNOB 2: BUDGET (8 to 32). The voice budget.
- KNOB 3: CLK (INT, USB, TRS). The clock source: INT, USB or TRS.
- KNOB 4: TUNE (-50 to 50). A global tuning offset.

#### SYSTEM

- KNOB 1: MIDI (USB, TRS). MIDI input, USB or TRS. The port's state shows next to it (RX when data came in recently).
- KNOB 2: DRUM (OFF, 1 to 16). The MIDI channel that plays the first drum track. 10 at first; a device setting.
- KNOB 3: ROUT (CH1-4, SEL, CH5-8, CH9-12, CH13-16). MIDI in: which four channels go to tracks 1 to 4 (SEL: every channel goes to the selected track).
- KNOB 4: CPU (read-out). The audio load in %. The knob does nothing.

#### WEIGHTS

- KNOB 1: P5 (AUTO or 1 to 15). Budget points per voice for this engine.
- KNOB 2: CZ-1 (AUTO or 1 to 15). As P5.
- KNOB 3: FM6 (AUTO or 1 to 15). As P5.
- KNOB 4: SID (AUTO or 1 to 15). As P5.

- These engines are not built into this build, so these four settings do nothing here.

#### WEIGHTS 2

- KNOB 1: DRUM (AUTO or 1 to 15). Points per DRUM voice (the DRUM engine is not built into this build).
- KNOB 2: BUDGET (8 to 32). The same value as GLOBAL's KNOB 2.
- KNOB 3: empty.
- KNOB 4: GUARD (OFF or ON). Whether an overload may cut voices.

### MIXER: the tracks

MIXER is the first page GLO opens (the owner's name for it is TRACKS).

#### MIXER

- KNOB 1: LEVEL (OFF or dB). The selected track's level (recorded as motion).
- KNOB 2: PAN (-100 to +98 %). The selected track's pan (recorded as motion).
- KNOB 3: FREEZE. Right freezes the selected track's phrase to a card file, left unfreezes. Needs a card in a powered hub.
- KNOB 4: MUTE (OFF or ON). Right is on, left is off.

- One row a track with its level bar and values in the knob colors. Unused tracks show a grey "Add track" row (MENU > UNUSED TRACKS). OCT+ held opens the sheet Track n / card: Assign clip (a WAV from the card). REC held (stopped) clears every track's steps, notes and own effects.

### SAVE: projects and sounds

SAVE tapped opens PROJECT. Tapped again: USER. SELECT inside the family steps PROJECT, PRESETS, USER (PRESETS is reached only this way). SAVE held, or SAVE + REC, quick-saves the project.

- OCT- = HOME. The keys play the track.

#### PRESETS

Only through SELECT inside the SAVE family (PROJECT, then PRESETS, then USER). A SAVE tap goes to PROJECT. The PRESETS encoder on HOME browses sounds without this page.

- KNOB 1: LIST (All, Faves, Recent, then Bass, Lead, Pad, Keys, Organ, Strings, Brass, Wind, Pluck, Bells, Drums, FX, Other). The list to browse. No wrap.
- KNOB 2: SOUND. The sound in the list (the same as the PRESETS encoder). A fast turn loads when it rests.
- KNOB 3: FAV (right marks, left unmarks). The shown sound's favourite star.
- KNOB 4: ENGINE. Next or previous engine; it loads that engine's first sound.

- OCT- goes back to HOME and undoes the sounds loaded since the page opened. OCT+ keeps the sound and goes to HOME. A key played commits the sound shown, then plays it.

#### USER

SAVE tapped on PROJECT, SELECT inside the SAVE family, or Save as user in the sound's sheet.

- KNOB 1 and KNOB 2 both pick the slot, U001 to U384, one a click. KNOB 3 and KNOB 4 do nothing.

- OCT+ opens the slot's sheet: Load, Save here (asks for a NAME; asks OVERWRITE on a used slot; refused while playing: "STOP TO SAVE"), Rename, Send (SysEx), Erase (asks). OCT+ held with KNOB 1 selects a run of slots; its sheet is Send selected, Erase selected, Clear selection.
- EDIT renames the slot. SAVE again goes to PROJECT.
- NAME screen: white keys type letters (tap again within 0.8 s for the next letter, 12 characters). Black keys: F# cursor left, G# space, A# cursor right, C# delete, D# letters or digits. KNOB 1 moves the cursor, KNOB 2 picks the character. OCT+ writes, OCT- cancels. The keys are silent.

#### PROJECT

- KNOB 1 and KNOB 2 both pick the row (A, B, C, D, the template T, then + New song). KNOB 3 and KNOB 4 do nothing.

- The rows are the four project slots A to D, the template T and "+ New song". The slot in use has its letter on a colored badge. The foot says the slot, its name and "saved", "unsaved" (changed since) or "not saved" (a new song).
- OCT+ opens the row's sheet: Load (asks first when there are unsaved changes), Save here (NAME screen; OVERWRITE on a used slot), Rename, Boot (load this project at power-on), Erase (asks). The template row has Load template and Save as template. On "+ New song" OCT+ starts it (asks if unsaved), then KEY (K1 ROOT, K2 SCALE, K3 TEMPO), then ROLES (K1 to K4: each track's role; OCT+ next or create, OCT- back).
- EDIT renames. SAVE held 0.7 s or SAVE + REC quick-saves (stopped only: "STOP TO SAVE").

### ARP: the arpeggiator

ARP tapped opens ARP, then ARP 2, then back. ARP held is the PERF layer.

- EDIT = the EDIT sheets. LFO held + a knob = momentary tweak. OCT- = HOME. With MODE not OFF the keys play the track through the arpeggiator (the ARP button blinks on the beat).

#### ARP

- KNOB 1: MODE (OFF, UP, DN, UPDN, RND, ORD, REPEAT). OFF, UP, DN, UPDN, RND, ORD or REPEAT.
- KNOB 2: RATE (1/4, 1/8, 1/16, 1/32, 8T, 16T, 1/2, 1/1, 2BAR, 4BAR). Arp step rate.
- KNOB 3: OCT (1 to 4). Octaves the arp spans.
- KNOB 4: GATE (1 to 100 %). Note length as a share of the step.

#### ARP 2

- KNOB 1: SWG (0 to 100 %). Swing of the arp.
- KNOB 2: PROB (0 to 100 %). Probability a note plays.
- KNOB 3: HOLD (OFF, ON). Hold: keeps notes after the keys are let go.
- KNOB 4: ORD (NOTE, PLAY). The order held notes are taken: NOTE or PLAY.

### SEQ: the sequencer pages

SEQ tapped opens the last SEQ page used (NOTES at first), and each tap steps on: NOTES, FEEL, TRACKER, GRID (pitched tracks only), PHRASE, GROOVE, TEMPO, CHAIN, SONG, PHRASES, MOTION (only once the track has motion), then NOTES. SELECT steps the same round. SEQ held 0.7 s jumps to CHAIN.

- EDIT = the EDIT sheets on the pages with no step editing. OCT- = HOME.

#### NOTES

The first SEQ page. A piano roll on a pitched track; the lane grid on a drum track.

- KNOB 1: PITCH. Pitch of the note at the cursor, a semitone a click. With nothing there it adds the last note played.
- KNOB 2: START. Where the note begins, step.hundredths, a sixteenth of a step a click. A typed note becomes a recorded note when moved.
- KNOB 3: LEN. The note's length in steps, a quarter step a click. ENV held: a sixteenth a click.
- KNOB 4: VEL (1 to 127). Velocity. With ENV held KNOB 4 becomes SLIDE, OFF or ON.

- PRESETS moves the cursor: each note of a chord, then the next step. ENV held + PRESETS zooms the roll (0 to 4). SELECT steps the page, not the cursor.
- ENV held + SELECT or KNOB 1 makes the note longer or shorter. SCL held + SELECT or KNOB 1 moves the note in time.
- OCT+ tap on an empty step adds a note; on a note it opens the note's sheet (Length, Velocity, Chance, Slide, Ratchet x1 to x4 and Flam, Condition, Nudge, Move note, Copy note, Delete note).
- OCT+ held with KNOB 1, KNOB 2 or SELECT selects a run of steps. On release its sheet: Move, Copy, Quantize, Delete selected, Clear selection. OCT- clears the selection. With nothing selected OCT+ held opens the Pattern sheet (Quantize, Shift right, Shift left, Reverse, Clear pattern, Clear motion).
- EDIT tap deletes the note at the cursor (or the selected run). EDIT held is undo; EDIT held + OCT+ redo.
- Keys enter notes at the cursor: the keys held together become the step (POLY up to 4 notes), and when all are let go the cursor moves on by the note's length. MENU > CHORD ENTRY = ADD makes each key add a note and keeps the cursor. MIDI notes enter the same way. With REC armed on the track the keys record live while the music plays instead of writing steps.
- Drum track (DRUM-X): KNOB 1 STEP (the cursor), KNOB 2 LANE (KICK to BELL), KNOB 3 HIT on or off at the cursor, KNOB 4 ACC on or off. The 16 white keys are the steps of the page shown (a tap toggles the picked lane there; ACC held toggles its accent). Black keys 1 to 8 pick and play a lane, black key 9 is ACC, black keys 10 and 11 page down and up. ACC + a lane key mutes that lane (not saved); ACC + OCT+ unmutes all. OCT+ on a hit opens its sheet; OCT+ held opens the grid's sheet (Copy lane, Paste lane, the Pattern rows). EDIT clears the step.
- PLAY loops the phrase. REC held (stopped) puts the page's 16 steps back to the defaults.

#### FEEL

- KNOB 1: CHNC (0 to 100 %, then FILL, !FILL, 1:2 to 4:4). Chance, then the trig conditions on one scale.
- KNOB 2: RATCH (x1 to x4, then FLAM). Hits in the step.
- KNOB 3: NUDGE (-32 to +31). Moves the step in 64ths of a step.
- KNOB 4: TYPE (-, ACC, SLD, A+S). Accent, slide or both.

- Four dials for the cursor step over 16 tiles. Each knob sets its value on every selected step; it needs a step with a note ("NO NOTE THERE").
- PRESETS moves the cursor. OCT+ held with KNOB 1, KNOB 2 or SELECT selects a range; HOME + PRESETS stretches it. There is no sheet. EDIT puts the cursor step's feel back to the defaults; HOME + EDIT does the whole range.
- The keys play the track (no step entry). REC held (stopped) resets the page's 16 steps' feel; it is refused while the track is armed ("STOP RECORDING").

#### TRACKER

- KNOB 1: ROW. The step.
- KNOB 2: COLUMN (N1, N2, N3, N4, VEL, FX). The column.
- KNOB 3: VALUE. In a note column: that note's pitch (an empty column adds a note). In VEL: velocity 1 to 127. In FX: which effect (RATCHET, CHANCE, CONDITION, NUDGE, SLIDE, ACCENT).
- KNOB 4: LENGTH. In a note column: the length in steps. In VEL: the length. In FX: the effect's amount (x2 to x4, FL, 50 %, 1:2, FIL, !FL, +3, SL, AC).

- The phrase as rows with the columns # N1 N2 N3 N4 VEL FX. The cursor cell is framed and the foot says what KNOB 3 and KNOB 4 do there.
- PRESETS: right shows every track as a lane, left goes back to this track.
- Keys write notes into the picked note column and the cursor moves down; several keys held make a chord across the columns. A key on a recorded step replaces the whole step.
- EDIT deletes: a note in a note column, the whole step in VEL, the picked effect in FX. ENV held + SELECT lengthens or shortens the note; SCL held + SELECT moves it. OCT+ tap opens the note's sheet; held, the Pattern sheet.
- A MONO, LEG or UNI track plays one note: "MONO TRACK: SET VOICE POLY" tells so. PLAY plays what it played last.

#### GRID

Pitched tracks only: not DRUM-X, not a kit, not a slice track.

- KNOB 1: STEP. The cursor; the page follows.
- KNOB 2: NOTE. Which note of the chord (n/N; REC for a recorded step).
- KNOB 3: PITCH. Pitch of that note.
- KNOB 4: LEN. Length of that note in steps.

- See "GRID keys" below for the keys. PRESETS moves the cursor; SELECT steps the page.

#### PHRASE

- KNOB 1: LEN (1 to 64 steps). The phrase length in steps (1 to 64).
- KNOB 2: DIV (1/4, 1/8, 1/16, 1/32, 8T, 16T, 1/2, 1/1, 2BAR, 4BAR). The length of a step: 1/4 to 4BAR.
- KNOB 3: SWG (0 to 100 %). The track's swing.
- KNOB 4: GATE (1 to 100 %). Note length as a share of the step.

- OCT+ held opens the Pattern sheet (as NOTES). REC held (stopped) puts LEN, DIV, SWG and GATE back to the defaults. Refused on a frozen phrase. PLAY loops the phrase.

#### GROOVE

- KNOB 1: GROOVE (OFF, LAID BACK, PUSH, DILLA, 2-STEP, DUB, HUMAN). The groove template for the selected track.
- KNOB 2: AMOUNT (0 to 100 % in steps of 5). How strongly it is applied.
- KNOB 3: empty.
- KNOB 4: empty.

- ALGORITHM picks the track. SWG on PHRASE and TEMPO still applies on top. The page draws a bar of 16 steps: straight places as thin lines, the groove's as blocks.

#### TEMPO

- KNOB 1: BPM (40 to 240 BPM). Tempo (also what SELECT turns at first).
- KNOB 2: SWG (0 to 100 %). The project's swing.
- KNOB 3: QNT (OFF, 1/4, 1/8, 1/16, 1/32, 8T, 16T, 1/2, 1/1, 2BAR, 4BAR). The selected track's record quantize.
- KNOB 4: empty.

- LFO held + KNOB 1 or 2 is a momentary tweak.

#### CHAIN

- KNOB 1: SLOT (A to P). The slot.
- KNOB 2: TRACK. The track.
- KNOB 3: PHRASE (00 to 64). The slot's phrase (00 is empty). A track playing that slot goes to the new phrase when the knob rests 0.3 s.
- KNOB 4: REPS (x1 to x16). Repeats; only for a slot with a phrase.

- Each track's chain, 8 of its 16 slots at a time. The picked slot is framed, the slot the track is on shows a progress bar.
- PRESETS puts the selected track onto the previous or next chain 01 to 64 (stopped only).
- OCT+ tap is GO: the track goes to the picked slot (stopped: at once; playing: at the launch point; an empty slot becomes a new phrase). OCT+ held opens the sheet: Insert slot, Duplicate slot, Own copy, Delete slot, Clear chain. OCT- clears a queued jump first, else HOME. PLAY plays each track's chain.

#### SONG

- KNOB 1: ROW (1 to 64). The song row.
- KNOB 2: TRACK. The track.
- KNOB 3: CHAIN (none, 01 to 64). The cell's chain.
- KNOB 4: empty.

- 64 rows, a column a track.
- OCT+ tap sends the selected track to the cell's chain and opens CHAIN (refused while playing). OCT+ held opens the sheet: Insert row, Delete row, Copy chain, Clear song, Free unused phrases.
- PLAY plays the song from the row picked. REC does not arm here.

#### PHRASES

- KNOB 1: PHRASE. The phrase.
- KNOB 2: ROW. A row of eight.
- KNOB 3: empty.
- KNOB 4: empty.

- An 8 x 8 grid of the 64 phrases. A phrase with notes is on the surface color; the one the selected track plays is filled; the one picked is framed.
- OCT+ tap puts the phrase into the chain slot picked on CHAIN. OCT+ held opens the sheet: Copy to new, Clear phrase (only if nothing names it).

#### MOTION

Only once the selected track has motion (record it by arming REC and turning a sound knob while the music plays).

- KNOB 1: PLAY. Right is on, left is off.
- KNOB 2: LANE. The lane.
- KNOB 3: STEP. The step, 1 to LEN.
- KNOB 4: VALUE. The value at that step (adds a point).

- SEQ held + KNOB 2 clears the lane; SEQ held + KNOB 4 deletes the point. OCT+ opens the lane's sheet: Play, Clear the lane, Clear all motion. REC held (stopped) clears the track's automation lanes.

## DUB performance view

HOME's DUB page. Set MENU > HOME PAGE to PICTURE, make sure the selected track's ECHO is above 0, then tap HOME on HOME until the tape loop shows. Tap HOME again, or press a page button, to leave. It needs the DUB TAPE module to sound.

- The four knobs: KNOB 1 FDBK, KNOB 2 SEND, KNOB 3 FILTER, KNOB 4 ECHO (0 to 127; ECHO 0 turns DUB off). A knob turned shows its value in the sound line.
- The keys are the octave C4 to B4, whatever OCT is set to. Every other key plays the track.
- They stay DUB's keys while GLO, SCL, ARP, FX or SEQ is held, so a KICK with a layer button still down never mutes a track. A layer locked open (double-tap) takes the whole keyboard.
- A throw replaces SEND while it is held. Another throw key held moves to its level; letting one go returns to the highest still held; letting the last go returns SEND to the knob.
- CUT shuts the loop's input and the wet. KICK strikes the spring. HOLD forces feedback to 1.00 while held. DIVE drops the repeats' speed an octave; RISE raises it an octave; both together are normal.
- Recording: with the track armed and recording, a throw is written as the SEND lane and CUT as the ECHO lane at 0. KICK, HOLD, DIVE and RISE sound but are not recorded (the page says "BLACK: NOT RECORDED").
- MIDI: CC 12 FDBK, CC 13 SEND, CC 14 FILTER, CC 15 ECHO. CC 16 THROW (the value is the send level while above 0; 0 releases), CC 17 CUT, CC 18 KICK, CC 19 HOLD, CC 20 DIVE, CC 21 RISE (64 or more is down). They work on the track's channel, are never stored, and CC 121 clears them.

The keys:

| Key | Does | Same by MIDI |
|---|---|---|
| C4 | THROW at 10 % of SEND | CC 16 value 13 |
| C#4 | KICK | CC 18 (64 or more is down) |
| D4 | THROW at 30 % of SEND | CC 16 value 38 |
| D#4 | HOLD | CC 19 (64 or more is down) |
| E4 | THROW at 50 % of SEND | CC 16 value 64 |
| F4 | THROW at 70 % of SEND | CC 16 value 89 |
| F#4 | nothing |  |
| G4 | THROW at 85 % of SEND | CC 16 value 108 |
| G#4 | DIVE | CC 20 (64 or more is down) |
| A4 | THROW at 100 % of SEND | CC 16 value 127 |
| A#4 | RISE | CC 21 (64 or more is down) |
| B4 | CUT | CC 17 (64 or more is down) |

## GRID keys

GRID is a SEQ page for pitched tracks. It has two stages and the corner of the screen says which: STEP (outlined) or NOTE (filled, with a frame round the screen).

- STEP stage (the keys are silent): a white key picks the step it stands for, 16 to a page (a step past LEN does nothing; nothing is written). The first four black keys, F#3 G#3 A#3 C#4, show pages 1 to 4 (steps 1 to 16, 17 to 32, 33 to 48, 49 to 64; a page past LEN does nothing). Other black keys do nothing.
- When you let go of the picking key the keys go to NOTE stage: the keys play, and the notes you play next become the picked step's notes. The first key starts the step afresh; keys held with it make a chord of up to 4; black keys are sharps.
- When every key is up the keys go back to STEP stage, on the same step. The cursor never advances by itself.
- OCT- in NOTE stage cancels: the step is as it was ("CANCELLED"). MIDI notes go into the picked step in either stage.
- EDIT deletes the picked note (the step when it is the last note). EDIT held is undo. There is no OCT+ sheet; velocity, accent, slide, ratchet, chance and conditions are in FEEL, TRACKER and the note's sheet on NOTES.
- With REC armed and the music playing the page is inert and the keys record live.

## MIDI

- Routing (GLO > SYSTEM): ROUT CH1-4 sends channels 1 to 4 to tracks 1 to 4 (other channels are ignored); SEL sends every channel to the selected track; CH5-8, CH9-12, CH13-16 send those four channels to tracks 1 to 4. A channel for a track not in use is ignored. The DRUM channel (10 at first) plays the first drum track. QNT MPC overrides note routing on every channel.
- Clock: CLK INT, USB or TRS picks which source's clock, start, continue and stop the unit follows. Clock and transport are accepted from USB or TRS only.
- Notes, pitch bend (range set by RPN: CC 101 and 100, then CC 6 and 38) and channel aftertouch are received. Program change and poly aftertouch are not.
- CCs received: 1 mod wheel, 2 breath, 4 foot, 5 glide time, 7 LEVEL, 10 PAN, 11 expression, 64 sustain, 65 portamento on or off, 71 and 74 the engine's macro knobs (on MACRO: 74 TIMB, 71 MRPH), 72 RELEASE, 73 ATTACK, 75 DECAY, 91 REVERB send, 93 CHORUS send, 94 DELAY send, 104 DIST, 12 to 21 the DUB controls, 98 to 101 and 6 and 38 for the bend range, 120 all sound off, 121 reset all controllers, 123 all notes off. Parameter CCs map 0 to 127 across the parameter's range on the routed track and are recorded as motion.
- Sent, over USB only: the keys you play, as note on (velocity 100) and note off on MIDI channel 1 to 4 for tracks 1 to 4 (ROUT does not change this). Layer keys, DUB keys, SEQ pattern keys and GRID's STEP stage send nothing. GLO + SELECT with GLO SELECT = MOD WHEEL sends CC 1. Nothing else is sent: no clock, no program change, no DIN output.

## Effects as modules

DUB TAPE is an effect module. With it installed, every track with ECHO above 0 runs it; without it such a track plays dry and the DUB pages say MODULE MISSING. Installing or removing it takes effect at once.

The FX button's pages are the same with or without it: an effect module adds, hides or renames no page on the unit. The modules are listed in the Effects table of the installer and the web app.

## The system menu

Hold HOME alone for 0.7 s to open it (a combo within 0.7 s is a SHIFT shortcut instead). KNOB 2 or PRESETS picks the row; KNOB 1 changes its value; OCT+ steps the value on (it wraps) or does the row's action. Leave with OCT- (from ABOUT back to the list first), OCT+ on BACK, or HOME held again. Settings are saved when it closes. Taps of SAVE, REC and HOME do nothing inside it.

- COLOR: The palette. KNOB 1 or OCT+ steps it (wraps). Four swatches show the track colors.
- HOLD: 0.3, 0.4, 0.5 or 0.6 s: how long GLO, SCL, ARP and FX are held before their layer opens.
- LIGHTS: OFF, LOW, MID, HIGH, FULL: how bright the keys' and buttons' lights are.
- USB AUDIO: The USB audio streams: IN+OUT, IN, OUT, OFF. The host gets it once the knob rests.
- USB INPUT: STEREO (the master) or 4 TRACKS (the four track stems).
- AUDIO CLICK: OFF, REC (only while a track is armed) or ON: a metronome click in the audio.
- CLICK LEVEL: LOW, MID or HIGH.
- COUNT-IN: OFF, 1 BAR or 2 BARS before PLAY starts while a track is armed for recording.
- NOTE PREVIEW: OFF or ON: plays the selected note when PRESETS (or KNOB 1 on NOTES) moves the cursor while stopped.
- CHORD ENTRY: HOLD: keys held together make the step's chord and the cursor advances. ADD: each key adds a note to the step, again removes it, and the cursor stays.
- AUTOSAVE: ON or OFF: the music is saved to its slot after five seconds stopped and untouched.
- PICKER POPUPS: ON or OFF: a card with the names around the value when a knob turns a value that is a name from a long list.
- KNOB ACCEL: ON or OFF: fast turns step more than one.
- HOME SELECT: What SELECT turns on HOME: BPM, MOD WHEEL (sent as CC 1), LEVEL, SWING, TRANSPOSE, CHORD, ARP RATE, CHAIN SLOT or OFF.
- HOME PAGE: HOME's first page: TRACKS (the default) or PICTURE. PICTURE adds the dials and picture page and the DUB page. Going back to TRACKS keeps the macro offsets in the sounds.
- GLO SELECT: The same choices: what SELECT turns with GLO held on any page.
- UNUSED TRACKS: SHOW (a grey "Add track" row on HOME's TRACKS and the mixer) or HIDE (tracks in use share the rows).
- SCREEN OFF: NEVER, 5 MIN, 15 MIN, 30 MIN or 60 MIN.
- CALIBRATION: OCT+ runs the HARDWARE CALIBRATION setup screen.
- ABOUT: OCT+ opens the credits and version. PRESETS scrolls; OCT- goes back.
- SOUND DESIGNER: OCT+ closes the menu and opens the sound designer, a step-by-step sound builder.
- BACK: OCT+ closes the menu.

## Where older notes differ

These points in older documents or notes do not match the Nightly. This guide follows the firmware.

- REC held does not open the mixer. Older notes say it does; on the Nightly it is the clear countdown when stopped and Capture when playing.
- SELECT on HOME does not step HOME's pages. A HOME tap does. SELECT turns MENU > HOME SELECT (BPM at first).
- MACRO's HOME knobs are MODL, HARM, TIMB, MRPH on the TRACKS page and HARM, TIMB, MRPH, PLUCK on the PICTURE page.
- EDIT tapped again on a sheet row goes to the next sheet; it does not show "the second page". SELECT steps the rows and PRESETS steps the sheets.
- DELAY's FDBK shows 0 to 94 %, not "past 100 %".
- SAVE does not reach PRESETS by a tap: SAVE opens PROJECT, then USER. PRESETS is reached with SELECT inside the SAVE pages.
- PLAY on TRACKER does not loop the phrase; it plays what it played last. Only NOTES and PHRASE loop it.
- The DUB page has more than the old three triggers: CC 16 to 21 are THROW, CUT, KICK, HOLD, DIVE and RISE.
- The FX order is SENDS, the shared pages, then the track's DIST, AUTO PAN, DUB SETUP, DUB, DUB 2.
- SEQ held is not only a jump to CHAIN: with it held the keys are the pattern keys and SELECT switches the pattern bank.
- HOME + OCT- and HOME + OCT+ (copy and paste) are not in this build.
